title: pipturus repandus
intro: Pipturus repandus, commonly known as Korean ginseng or yangmei, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include improving immune function, reducing inflammation, and enhancing cognitive function. The therapeutic actions of Pipturus repandus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective properties. The bioactive constituents in Pipturus repandus have been shown to have potential therapeutic applications, including neurodegenerative disease prevention and cardiovascular health promotion.
